title: A Visit to the Library
description: Anna and Hoa borrow books at the library.
instructions: Read about Anna and Hoa. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 📚 Anna goes to the library every Friday after school. Today she went with her friend Hoa.
The library is a big, quiet building next to the park. A kind woman called Mrs Green works there. She wears glasses and a yellow dress.
Anna wanted a book about horses. Mrs Green showed her a shelf near the window. Anna chose a book with a brown horse on the cover.
Hoa likes stories about animals, but she wanted a funny book today. She found a book about a silly monkey. She laughed and a man said, 'Please be quiet!'
The girls sat at a table and read for an hour. Then they went to the desk and borrowed their books. They can keep the books for two weeks.
At four o'clock, they left the library. 'I love this place,' said Anna. 'I want to come again next Friday!'
